name: So San
meaning: Named after the monk Choi Hyong Ung (1520-1604), whose pen name was So-San. The 72 movements recall his age when he raised an army of warrior monks with his pupil Sa Myunh Dang to help drive off the Japanese pirates who overran much of Korea in 1592.
endingPosition: Bring the right foot back to a ready posture
diagram: Diagram image using points A, B, C and D; no written layout on the page.
